excerpt_i18n.en: Shenzhen, July 23 – The Hi3D Physical Creative Ecosystem closed-door meeting was held in Shenzhen. Centered on the theme "Exploring the Next Generation of AI-Driven Manufacturable Ecosystem," Hi3D, along with guests from 3D printing hardware, manufacturing, creator, and maker communities, discussed the new trend of AI 3D transitioning from digital generation to physical manufacturing. This also marked the first time Ren Lifeng, founder and CEO of Shumei Wanwu, publicly represented Hi3D to systematically share the company's technological progress and industrial insights over the past year with media, equipment manufacturers, and industry partners. Jia Rongfei, co-founder and head of algorithms at Shumei Wanwu, also presented the milestone advancements in Hi3D's algorithm model optimization over the past year. On-site, Hi3D announced the upcoming launch of the next-generation Hi3D 3.0 2048³ model, defining the new SOTA for next-gen 3D general-purpose large models. For the first time, Hi3D systematically outlined its "Physical Creative Ecosystem" strategy: AI 3D is evolving from a mere model generation tool into a connector of creativity, models, equipment, materials, and manufacturing, enabling ideas from the digital world to truly enter the physical world. From "Democratizing Expression" to "Democratizing Creation" "We firmly believe that technology should serve people's desire to create and express," said Ren Lifeng. In the past, the internet continuously lowered the barrier to content expression through text, images, and short videos. Now, the development of AI and desktop manufacturing technologies has multiplied the number of AI 3D users ninefold in two years, driving the next wave of change from the digital realm to the physical world. Hi3D aims to advance the shift from "democratizing expression" to "democratizing creation."
excerpt_i18n.es: Shenzhen, 23 de julio — La reunión a puerta cerrada del ecosistema creativo de entidades Hi3D se celebró en Shenzhen. En torno al tema "Explorando el ecosistema de fabricación de próxima generación impulsado por IA", Hi3D debatió con invitados del ámbito del hardware de impresión 3D, la fabricación, los creadores y el sector Maker sobre las nuevas tendencias de la IA 3D que pasa de la generación digital a la fabricación física. Esta fue también la primera vez que Ren Lifeng, fundador y CEO de Shumei Wanwu, representó a Hi3D tras emprender su proyecto, compartiendo sistemáticamente con los medios, fabricantes de equipos y socios industriales los avances tecnológicos y las reflexiones industriales de Hi3D durante el último año. Jia Rongfei, cofundador y responsable de algoritmos de Shumei Wanwu, también presentó en el evento los hitos logrados en la optimización de modelos algorítmicos de Hi3D durante el año pasado.

items.raw_excerpt: 7月23日，即梦AI联合抖音电商、艾菲奖共同发起 “AI 广告爆改大赛”，邀请网友围绕经典广告语、经典广告场景和大众记忆中的品牌内容，使用 AI 技术进行创意改编与视频创作，让经典广告焕发全新生命力。 艾菲奖是国际上具有影响力的实效营销与广告传播奖项体系之一，每年持续认可和表彰最具实效的品牌，营销机构及代理机构。作为本次大赛官方合作发起方，艾菲奖的加入为赛事增添了专业度与行业影响力。 本次大赛由李诞发起，经典广告等您来演 本次大赛获得王老吉、旺旺、玛氏、喜之郎、优乐美、溜溜梅、卡姿兰等多个知名品牌授权，聚焦 “经典回忆” 与 “品牌焕新” 两大方向，设置了品牌赛道与公益赛道等五个创作方向。参赛者可围绕熟悉的广告语、经典场景等进行剧情爆改、脑洞续写、公益表达等多元创作，探索 AI 技术在广告创意中的更多可能。 创作形式上，大赛分为“演绎爆改”和“创意手搓”两个类型。前者主要面向即梦 App 端，创作者可借助分身演绎、一键跟拍等能力生成12秒以内短视频；后者面向即梦 Web 端，鼓励创作者通过剧情反转、视觉特效、完整故事设定等方式，制作12秒以上创意视频。参赛作品需在抖音平台及对应即梦端内发布，并带上大赛主话题及赛道话题。 本次赛事投稿时间将持续至 8月20日，并于8月28日公布最终获奖名单。大赛专业评审团将从用户喜爱、创新能力、技术水平、故事设定、视听表达等维度进行综合评选，最终评选出117条优秀作品。各赛道获奖者将获得现金激励、即梦 AI 积分及艾菲奖荣誉证书等奖励。 即梦 AI 相关负责人表示，广告创作是 AI 视频能力落地的重要场景之一，此次联合抖音电商和艾菲奖发起AI广告爆改大赛，是希望借助品牌经典内容为创作者提供具体实践场景，探索AI 创作在广告创意表达中的实际应用。 雷峰网 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, the Seed Edge team officially launched the Seed STEM Scientist Plan. The plan aims to invite 100 scholars from frontier scientific fields to collaborate with the Seed team on real-world scientific problems, identify and break through research-level challenges, and jointly explore the potential of AI in accelerating scientific discovery. In recent years, large models have made significant progress in tasks such as general question answering, coding, and mathematical reasoning, but they still face more complex challenges in real scientific problems. Against this backdrop, the Seed Edge team initiated the Seed STEM Scientist Plan. It is understood that the plan focuses on AI research in science, and participating scholars will work with the Seed team on more creative scientific exploration. The plan has specific expectations for the scholars' research backgrounds and AI experience, hoping that they have obtained or are pursuing a PhD in STEM-related disciplines, possess deep academic knowledge and thorough disciplinary understanding, have a strong interest and firm belief in AI-accelerated scientific discovery, and can clearly assess the value and current limitations of AI in their field. Additionally, participants are expected to use AI as a productivity tool extensively in their daily research work. Scholars in relevant fields can choose to join the project as scientist advisors or doctoral interns based on their circumstances. The first phase of the STEM Scientist Plan is expected to last approximately six months, during which participating scholars will need to come to the Seed office to work with the team.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 23 de julio, el equipo Seed Edge lanzó oficialmente el programa Seed STEM Scientist. En los últimos años, los grandes modelos han logrado avances significativos en tareas como respuestas generales, código y razonamiento matemático, pero aún enfrentan desafíos más complejos en problemas reales de investigación científica. items.title: 腾讯混元组织架构再升级，合并大语言模型和多模态团队，加速模型研发
items.raw_excerpt: 7 月 23 日，腾讯宣布混元多模态模型部门与大语言模型部门合并，成立基础模型部，统一由腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨管理，以进一步提升模型研发和协同效率，探索全模态模型的智能上限。 以大语言模型为基础，腾讯混元构建了图像、视频、语音、3D 生成模型等完整的模型矩阵。2026 年以来，腾讯混元模型迭代速度不断加快，与腾讯公司业务的协同也持续增强。 7 月正式上线的大语言模型 Hy3，展现出显著强于同尺寸模型且比肩参数规模 2-5 倍的旗舰模型的智能水平，已在 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy、元宝、Marvis、ima 等多个业务接入，API 已在腾讯云 TokenHub 以及多个海外平台上线。发布一周后， Hy3 总调用量较上一代模型（Hy2）增长超 68 倍，WorkBuddy 自选模型的用户中，选择 Hy3 的占比达到 60%。 混元多模态模型也在持续进化。4 月发布并开源的混元 3D 世界模型 2.0（Hy World 2.0）能够根据文字、图片、视频等不同类型输入，自动生成、重建和模拟 3D 世界，同时支持多格式 3D 资产导出，能与现有的游戏工作流无缝对接，快速生成游戏地图和关卡原型。混元 3D 系列模型的社区下载量超过 300 万，是全球最受欢迎的 3D 开源模型。混元图像模型3.0 在 LMArena 榜单上居国内开源模型第一。 雷峰网 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, Tencent announced the merger of its Hunyuan multimodal model department and large language model department to form a foundation model department, unified under the management of Tencent's Chief AI Scientist Yao Shunyu, aiming to further improve model development and collaboration efficiency and explore the intelligence ceiling of full multimodal models. Based on large language models, Tencent Hunyuan has built a complete model matrix including image, video, voice, and 3D generation models. Since 2026, the iteration speed of Tencent Hunyuan models has been accelerating, and their synergy with Tencent's business has been continuously strengthening. The large language model Hy3, officially launched in July, has demonstrated significantly stronger intelligence than models of the same size and on par with flagship models with 2-5 times the parameter size. It has been integrated into multiple businesses such as WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, Marvis, and ima, with APIs available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub and multiple overseas platforms. One week after release, the total invocation volume of Hy3 increased more than 68 times compared to the previous generation model (Hy2), and among users who chose WorkBuddy's optional models, the proportion selecting Hy3 reached 60%. The Hunyuan multimodal model is also continuously evolving. The Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 (Hy World 2.0), released and open-sourced in April, can automatically generate, reconstruct, and simulate 3D worlds based on different input types such as text, images, and videos.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 23 de julio, Tencent anunció la fusión del departamento de modelos multimodales Hunyuan con el departamento de modelos de lenguaje grandes, creando el Departamento de Modelos Base, gestionado de manera unificada por el científico jefe de IA de Tencent, Yao Shunyu, para mejorar la eficiencia en la investigación y desarrollo de modelos y la colaboración, y explorar el límite de inteligencia de los modelos multimodales completos. Basándose en modelos de lenguaje grandes, Tencent Hunyuan ha construido una matriz completa de modelos que incluye generación de imágenes, video, voz y 3D. Desde 2026, la velocidad de iteración del modelo Tencent Hunyuan se ha acelerado constantemente, y la sinergia con el negocio de Tencent también se ha fortalecido. El modelo de lenguaje grande Hy3, lanzado oficialmente en julio, muestra un rendimiento significativamente superior a modelos del mismo tamaño y comparable a modelos insignia con parámetros de 2 a 5 veces mayores.

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 22, 2026, Acemate officially signed a partnership agreement with the 2026 China Open. According to the cooperation terms, Acemate will serve as the exclusive designated tennis training robot supplier for the 2026 China Open, entering the event's partnership ecosystem. The significance of this collaboration goes beyond a mere event sponsorship announcement. For Acemate, this marks an important milestone as its AI tennis training robot moves from daily training, club experiences, and shared court settings into the professional tournament ecosystem. It signifies that the new category of AI tennis training robots is entering a more authentic, higher-standard tennis environment with greater public visibility. The China Open is one of Asia's highest-level combined men's and women's international tennis tournaments. As a key platform connecting Chinese tennis to the global stage, the China Open not only hosts top-tier competitive content but also continuously expands the integration of event experiences, fan interaction, and sports technology. Acemate's entry into the China Open partnership is based on a shared focus on upgrading tennis training experiences. Unlike traditional ball-feeding devices, the Acemate AI tennis training robot possesses capabilities such as movement, ball reception, serving, human-robot rallying, and training data recording and analysis. Through AI visual perception and robotic motion control, Acemate aims to elevate solo tennis training beyond one-way ball feeding, progressively approaching the movement, judgment, and continuous rallying of real matches.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 22 de julio de 2026, Acemate y el China Open 2026 formalizaron su acuerdo. Según los términos, Acemate será el proveedor exclusivo designado de robots de entrenamiento de tenis para el China Open 2026, integrándose en el escenario de colaboración del torneo. La relevancia de este acuerdo va más allá de un simple anuncio de patrocinio deportivo. Para Acemate, supone un hito clave en la transición de los robots de entrenamiento de tenis con IA desde el entrenamiento diario, la experiencia en clubes y las pistas compartidas hacia el sistema de competiciones profesionales. Esto implica que esta nueva categoría de robots de entrenamiento de tenis con IA está entrando en escenarios más reales, de mayor nivel y más exigentes.
